# Phase report template

Status: template — no measurements or results exist.

## Result and scope

State the demonstrated capability, engineering outcome and supported research conclusion separately.

## Method and provenance

Record phase/release/run IDs, source/patch revision, model/processor/adapter revisions, data/split/protocol hashes, actual host inventory, resolved configuration and exact commands. Link the manifest.

## Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Result | Evidence | Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending | Not run | None | Pending |

## Measurements

Show applicable trial/attempt counts, valid outcomes, failures, retries, exclusions and denominator definitions. Record measured time, memory, storage and uncertainty; mark unavailable values with a reason. Non-experiment phases state which metrics are not applicable.

## Findings and limitations

Separate observed behavior from explanations or hypotheses. Include failures and protocol deviations. Do not infer useful learning from a loss reduction or checkpoint save alone.

## Media and reproducibility

Link source tables, generated figures, video selection/timing manifest, raw evidence and the tested runbook. State how exported artifacts were validated.

## Next decision

Name the exact prerequisite for the next release and any planned scope change.
